# Chigbu Law (Clifford Chigbu, Attorney at Law)

> Solo law practice in Elk Grove, California, led by attorney Clifford C. Chigbu
> (State Bar of California #221386). Main focus: family law and immigration.
> English and Spanish spoken.

## Practice areas
- Family law: divorce and legal separation, child custody and visitation, child and spousal support, domestic violence restraining orders, adoption, paternity, property division, prenuptial agreements
- Immigration: family-based green cards, visas, citizenship, DACA, deportation defense, business immigration
- Also: business law, bankruptcy (Chapter 7 and 13), auto accident and personal injury, estate planning (wills, trusts, probate)

## Where we work
Elk Grove and Sacramento County, California.
